show.description: Rehan, a betrayed husband on his deathbed, is granted a shocking second chance: he wakes up in 1998, determined to rewrite his fate. As he navigates love, betrayal, and ruthless power games, Rehan uses his future knowledge to protect Simran and build a business empire into a gripping time-travel saga.
